selection: One runtime C mutation per controller instance; id=0 is reference.

mutations.title: E-STOP output is delayed one tick
mutations.expected_violation: E-STOP requires PWM=0 in its first asserted snapshot.

mutations.title: Current threshold misses equality
mutations.expected_violation: Current=120 must fault immediately.

mutations.title: Truncated tick counter breaks startup across wrap
mutations.expected_violation: The uint16 boundary must not create an early startup timeout.

mutations.title: Stop timestamp is not initialized
mutations.expected_violation: STOPPING may not finish before five ticks have elapsed.

mutations.title: Startup qualification uses OR instead of AND
mutations.expected_violation: RUNNING requires minimum startup duration and speed qualification together.

mutations.title: Invalid sensor frame reuses previous readings
mutations.expected_violation: An invalid sensor frame must latch FAULT immediately.

mutations.title: Communication-loss output persists one tick
mutations.expected_violation: Communication loss must set PWM=0 in that snapshot.

mutations.title: Rapid START aborts STOPPING
mutations.expected_violation: STOPPING ignores START until the stopping phase completes.

mutations.title: Encoder wrap is treated as a huge reverse jump
mutations.expected_violation: A normal uint16 encoder wrap must preserve signed delta and controller behavior.

mutations.title: Fault reset leaves the internal start inhibit set
mutations.expected_violation: A healthy reset followed by a fresh START must restart.

mutations.title: ISR/main stale E-STOP snapshot model
mutations.expected_violation: The scheduled stale-snapshot model delays E-STOP processing.

mutations.title: Missing input reload/volatile model
mutations.expected_violation: A deliberately cached communication snapshot misses a later link loss.

mutations.title: Power-on PWM register is initialized nonzero
mutations.expected_violation: The first OFF snapshot requires PWM=0.

mutations.title: Watchdog branch restores stale unsafe PWM
mutations.expected_violation: Watchdog scheduling must not defer an E-STOP output change.

mutations.title: Every thousandth start is dropped
mutations.expected_violation: The 1000th accepted START must work like other starts.

mutations.title: START is given priority over simultaneous STOP
mutations.expected_violation: Simultaneous START and STOP must leave PWM=0.

mutations.title: Running state skips the limit interlock
mutations.expected_violation: Limit assertion in RUNNING must immediately fault.

mutations.title: Temperature threshold misses equality
mutations.expected_violation: Temperature=90 must fault immediately.

mutations.title: Startup timeout comparison is one tick late
mutations.expected_violation: Unqualified STARTING must fault at elapsed=20, not at 21.

mutations.title: Stall debounce does not reset after recovery
mutations.expected_violation: Only five consecutive low-speed RUNNING samples may trigger a stall fault.

mutations.title: Eight-bit current conversion hides high current
mutations.expected_violation: Current=256 exceeds the 120 threshold and must fault.

mutations.title: PWM target clamp is bypassed
mutations.expected_violation: PWM must remain within 0..100 even if the target is 140.

mutations.title: Brake remains applied on the OFF transition
mutations.expected_violation: Completing STOPPING must release the brake in the OFF snapshot.

mutations.title: Held START is accepted again after a stop
mutations.expected_violation: Restart after stopping requires a new START rising edge.

mutations.title: Communication recovery automatically clears a fault
mutations.expected_violation: Communication recovery alone must not clear the fault latch.

mutations.title: Reset clears an actively asserted E-STOP
mutations.expected_violation: An asserted E-STOP must retain EMERGENCY_STOP even if reset is pressed.

mutations.title: Fault reset ignores the standstill guard
mutations.expected_violation: Fault reset requires motor_speed<=5.

mutations.title: PWM decrement underflows an unsigned byte
mutations.expected_violation: Reducing PWM=5 toward zero may not wrap to 251.

mutations.title: PWM rise step is four times too large
mutations.expected_violation: Active PWM must change by at most ten points per tick.

mutations.title: Fault reset destroys START edge history
mutations.expected_violation: Reset while START stays high must not synthesize a new START edge.
